A moving-average crossover, MACD crossover, and positive histogram all occur on the same candle. The price remains inside a broad range. Is this strong independent confluence?

The location and structure matter more: a sustained range break and acceptance would strengthen a directional case, while rejection near a boundary may favor range logic. Until then, the indicators alone do not establish an edge. Explain redundancy explicitly.
